name: minimalist-museum-muse
image_purpose: show a modern high-fashion portrait in an art museum

prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman with long chestnut-brown hair, intense composed gaze, natural sculpted feminine silhouette, ivory sleeveless silk top, structured black asymmetric mini skirt, black pointed heels, minimal silver earrings and thin metallic clutch.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body vertical portrait in a contemporary museum hall, strong three-quarter stance between large abstract sculptures, one leg extended slightly forward, white walls, polished concrete, skylights and art installations.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Diffused neutral daylight from overhead skylights, soft sculpting shadows enhancing form without harsh contrast.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame professional mirrorless look, 85mm f/1.4, f/1.8, ISO 125, 1/800s, eye autofocus, slightly low perspective, neutral daylight white balance, cinematic texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic full-body contemporary museum fashion portrait of one generic approved adult woman with long chestnut-brown hair and composed gaze, ivory silk sleeveless top, structured black asymmetric mini skirt, pointed black heels, silver earrings and thin clutch, standing between abstract sculptures in a white museum hall with polished concrete and skylights, diffused daylight, 85mm editorial realism, elegant balanced anatomy.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, transparent clothing, sexualized posing, fetish styling, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed

assets.name: minimalist-museum-muse-reference
assets.usage: Match the subject, wardrobe, props, environment, composition, and lighting. Replaceable with another approved reference for the same concept.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve generic approved adult identity cues, wardrobe, pose, props, environment, composition, lighting, and architecture. Optional replacements may change hair, colors, room, flowers, or accessories while retaining the concept. Preserve face and facial structure when a face reference is used; keep logos and typography absent or neutral.
